voices.you: Louie the Legend ataV0GNgfIus2NWdTJP0 (expressive young male creator)

lines: [panicked] LUMI. I haven't posted in three weeks.
[calm, confident] Talk to me. Two minutes. About anything.
Step one. Record a voice memo. [warm] Your phone turns it into text.
[proud] Step two. Paste it into ChatGPT with my prompt. Thirty post ideas.
[amazed, laughing] Thirty?! From my coffee rant?
[warm] Step three. Every idea gets a hook, a caption and slides.
Step four. Schedule all thirty in Meta Business Suite. [warm] It's free.
[excited] A whole month... in one night!
[shocked, shouting] Wait. Eighty thousand views?! On the coffee one?
[scheming, quiet] Okay. Just be me. [hopeful] Post forever?
[softly, warm] They follow you, not me. Your voice is the content.
[friendly] Send this to a creator who hasn't posted in weeks. Follow next level social, and comment posts. I'll send you the prompt.
